supersedes: shot_bible.json (v1.0), which is retained only as a record of INTENT
purpose: The single authoritative shot bible for the LOCAL open-weight rebuild of the 43.000s / 1290-frame vertical reel, built as a quality A/B against the delivered cloud master. The unit of this file is the SUB-SHOT, not the macro window; macro windows survive only as a grouping key. It states WHAT must be in frame and WHEN, not how to prompt any one model.

character_policy.rule: The two leads are ORIGINAL FICTIONAL PEOPLE, modelled on nobody real. Characters are addressed ONLY as M1 (male lead), F1 (female lead), F2_VEILED (the veiled figure in macro 11), CORPS_A (the studio ensemble) and CORPS_B (the desert ensemble). No real person's name, no actor, no television character and no series title appears in any field, filename or comment in this file, including in the negative prompts - the project gate forbids the tokens outright, so they cannot be used even to exclude them.

precedence.rule: FRAMES OF THE MASTER BEAT OBSERVATIONS. OBSERVATIONS BEAT THE OLD BIBLE. The old bible and the execution blueprint record INTENT ONLY and may be cited as intent, never as a description of the delivered film. A generative render does not obey its prompt; treating prompt text as a description of the output is the exact error that produced v1.0 of this file. Where a document and a frame disagree, the frame wins, and the disagreement is written down.

2. subshots.json - the measured sub-shot cut list.

beat_drop.why: 6.920s is not on the detected beat grid; the nearest detected beat is at 7.1668s, and the flux envelope shows no energy step anywhere between 6s and 7s. The documented pair is also internally inconsistent: at 30fps, 6.920s is frame 207.6 and frame 208 is 6.9333s.

beat_grid_policy.rule: SUB-SHOT BOUNDARIES COME FROM THE MASTER'S MEASURED CUTS AND ARE NOT SNAPPED TO THE BEAT GRID.
beat_grid_policy.why: The existing edit was cut to content, not to the beat. Measured against the documented window table, only 1 of the 11 macro cuts lands within +-80ms of a detected beat and the worst is off by 272ms. Snapping our boundaries to beats would move them away from the master's cuts and desync the rebuild from the very thing it is being compared against - the A/B would then be measuring an edit difference rather than a model difference.
beat_grid_policy.caveat: That beat-alignment statistic was computed against the DOCUMENTED cut frames, which COR-01 shows are wrong by 33ms to 333ms. The statistic is therefore itself suspect. The conclusion is unaffected and in fact strengthened: the cuts are not on the grid, and we are not putting them there.

master_timeline.frame_convention: Every [start, end] pair in this file is HALF-OPEN: start inclusive, end exclusive. frames = end - start. The 38 sub-shots tile 0 to 1290 with no gap and no overlap.

sets.name: Red cyclorama studio, bright crimson state
sets.physical_note: SET_A and SET_B are the SAME physical red cyclorama build in two dressing and grade states. They are split because a generator fed one clause will not produce the other.
sets.backdrop: Seamless painted crimson cyclorama, no corner seam, no horizon, no wall-floor junction. Lit across the upper two thirds and vignetting softly at the corners - never black. Measured RGB(149,8,1) to RGB(167,18,13) at head height, falling to RGB(100,5,2) at the edges.
sets.floor: Matte red-painted / red-carpeted deck, duller and browner than the cyc, measured RGB(104,18,19).
sets.risers: A five-tread staircase to a flat top platform, entirely draped in crimson velvet with visible folds, cornered seams and a skirt pooling on the deck. Re-dressed in macro 06 as a long straight red-carpet runway roughly two treads high, and in 11c as low velvet-draped theatre tiers.
sets.lighting: Single high frontal warm tungsten key ~3200K, roughly 20-30 degrees camera-LEFT and 30-40 degrees above the eye line. NO artificial fill - the whole fill is red bounce off the cyc, so the shadow side of every face reads red, not grey. Soft single shadows on the treads.
sets.rim: A narrow, SOFT-edged cyan-teal lip, hue ~183, on the camera-left shoulder and jawline. 0.3-1.3% of frame; 10.6% at f377 only.
sets.prompt_clause: Shot on a seamless saturated fire-engine red cyclorama with no corner seam and no visible horizon; the backdrop is fully lit across the upper two thirds and vignettes softly to a deeper red at the frame corners, never to black. The floor is a matte red-painted deck and the riser is a five-tread staircase and flat top platform fully draped in crimson velvet with visible drape folds and cornered seams. Everything in the set is red. Lit by a single high frontal warm tungsten key, about 3200 kelvin, placed roughly twenty degrees camera-left and thirty degrees above the eye line; there is no artificial fill, so the shadow side of every face is filled only by red bounce off the cyclorama and reads warm red rather than grey. A narrow, soft-edged cyan-teal edge light rims the camera-left shoulder and jawline and separates black wardrobe from the red field - a thin lip, not a broad wrap. Shadows on the riser are soft-edged and single. Warm skin, matte black wardrobe, bone-white shirting and gold metal are the only colours besides red. Medium contrast, rich blacks, filmic grain, anamorphic portrait framing.

sets.name: Red cyclorama studio, low-key oxblood state
sets.physical_note: The same cyclorama keyed down roughly two stops and re-dressed.
sets.backdrop: Deep oxblood falling to effectively black at the corners; dark warm brown bokeh at shallow depth. Measured RGB(40-56, 0-5, 8-10). This is the closest the film comes to the old bible's near-black backdrop, and even here it is red.
sets.floor: The same red deck, dark and largely unlit. MACRO 03 IS THE EXCEPTION: a hot magenta / pink carpet runway.
sets.risers: Dark red velvet steps and treads, measured RGB(90,13,13). MACRO 07 IS THE EXCEPTION: a large low flat-topped plinth whose TOP IS TAN TERRACOTTA, measured RGB(218,140,76), with a red carpet skirt below it.
sets.lighting: TWO hard high frontal keys about 20 degrees either side of the lens axis, warm-neutral, throwing CRISP DOUBLE SHADOWS on the plinth top. No fill at all; shadows drop unfilled to black. Steepest contrast in the film.
sets.rim: NONE in the intimate and plinth shots - 0.000% cool pixels measured at eleven separate frames. The only exceptions are the two backlit crowd wides of macro 03, which do carry a narrow lip.
sets.prompt_clause: Shot on the same red cyclorama keyed down two stops: a deep oxblood field that falls off to near-black at the frame corners, rendering as dark warm brown bokeh when the lens is open. The floor is dark red deck; where a plinth appears its top is tan terracotta velvet, the single warmest and lightest surface in frame, with a red carpet skirt below it. Lit by two hard high frontal sources about twenty degrees either side of the lens axis, warm neutral, throwing crisp sharp-edged double shadows on the plinth top. No fill at all: shadows drop unfilled to black. There is no rim light of any colour - separation comes from the hard key and from the backdrop falling away behind the subject. Low chroma for a red set, roughly half the saturation of the bright state. Matte black wardrobe, antique gold trim, bone-white shirting, warm skin. High contrast, deep crushed blacks, filmic grain, anamorphic portrait framing.

sets.name: Desert quarry exterior with red modular props
sets.physical_note: A real exterior location occupying f772-f1086, 315 frames, 24.4% of the film. The old bible barely records it.
sets.backdrop: No backdrop. An eroded sand and clay quarry face rilled with vertical erosion gullies rising the full height of frame, sparse dark scrub on the ridge line, clear unclouded deep slate-blue sky above. Cliff measured RGB(88-139, 66-108, 40-65); sky RGB(51-55, 69-93, 87-121). The only large blue field in the film.
sets.floor: Flat compacted pale sand and gravel pan, RGB(82,67,53) in shade to RGB(155,131,92) in sun.
sets.dressing: One large freestanding rectangular portal frame painted saturated matte red, measured RGB(191,60,46), standing in the sand - and ten to fourteen knee-high matte red cubes laid out in two converging rows forming an aisle, RGB(102,23,20) in shade. That red is the only saturated colour in the set and the visual tie back to the studio.
sets.lighting: Direct hard low-angle SUN from camera-left and slightly behind, roughly 5400K graded warm-golden, with crisp single hard shadows raking the sand and generous warm bounce off sand and open sky. NO artificial rim: the bright edges on cream cloth are sun. Brightest and flattest-shadowed windows in the film.
sets.prompt_clause: Shot on location in an eroded sand and clay quarry: an ochre-tan cliff face rilled with vertical erosion gullies fills the background to the full height of frame, with sparse dark scrub on the ridge line and a clear unclouded deep slate-blue sky above it. The ground is a flat compacted pale sand and gravel pan. Dressed with one large freestanding rectangular portal frame painted saturated matte red, and ten to fourteen knee-high matte red cubes laid out in two converging rows forming an aisle; that red is the only saturated colour in the set. Lit by direct hard low-angle daylight sun from camera-left and slightly behind, roughly 5400 kelvin graded warm golden, with crisp single hard shadows raking across the sand and generous warm bounce fill off the sand and open sky. No artificial rim: the bright edges on pale costume are sun. Bright overall, low saturation apart from the red props, wide exposure range from deep hat-brim shadow to near-clipping sunlit cream. Filmic grain, anamorphic portrait framing.

native_generation.still: Flux.2 [dev] fp8, 832x1792, ~107s per image. ZERO LoRAs, ZERO ControlNets, ZERO IP-Adapter or InstantID. Character consistency rests entirely on Flux.2 native multi-reference: one ReferenceLatent per reference image, chained POSITIVE-ONLY and UNWEIGHTED, addressed in the prompt text as Figure 1..N.
native_generation.video: HunyuanVideo 1.5 720p image-to-video, native 24 fps, 720x1280 portrait, roughly 19 MINUTES per five-second clip.
native_generation.schema_authority: node_schemas.json overrides every guess. TRAP-01: HunyuanVideo15ImageToVideo has THREE outputs and latent is index 2. TRAP-05: the Flux.2 still stage has NO negative conditioning at all. TRAP-07: reference images are normalised to 1 megapixel with upscale_method area before encoding.

one_file_per_subshot.delivery_rule: Each file must deliver AT LEAST its sub-shot frame count PLUS 12 frames of headroom at 30 fps, so that the lead-in latent freeze and the seam can both be trimmed at assembly without conforming the window.

steps: 1. Generate N frames at 24 fps with HunyuanVideo15ImageToVideo. N must be of the form 4n+1 (the node's length input has step 4) and N <= N_max.
2. RIFE x5 upsampling through the FrameInterpolate node (ComfyUI core, true multi-timestep, not a recursive 2x). Output frame count = (N - 1) * 5 + 1, which is 120 fps material.
3. Keep every 4th frame of that 120 fps sequence to land on 30 fps. Frames retained = floor(((N-1)*5) / 4) + 1.
4. Trim to the sub-shot's exact frame count at assembly, discarding the lead-in freeze first.
frame_arithmetic_chain.worked_example: N = 41 -> (41-1)*5+1 = 201 frames at 120 fps -> keep every 4th -> 51 frames at 30 fps -> trim to the sub-shot's 37 frames, leaving 14 frames of headroom.
frame_arithmetic_chain.memory_warning: That node preallocates the entire output in CPU RAM - roughly 15 GB for 601 frames at 1080p. Run the stage on ONE clip at a time, never batched.

n_max_plan.status: N_max IS NOT CONFIRMED. The 121-frame benchmark is still running and the VAE decode stage may still out-of-memory. N_max is treated as a PARAMETER here, not an assumption.
n_max_plan.result: NO SUB-SHOT EXCEEDS ANY CANDIDATE N_max, INCLUDING THE WORST CASE OF 61.
n_max_plan.why: The longest sub-shot is 02b at 59 frames of timeline; with 12 frames of headroom that needs 71 frames at 30 fps, which needs N = 57 at 24 fps. 57 <= 61.
n_max_plan.consequence: The EDITORIAL cut list is the only thing that sets the generation count. N_max does not add a single split, so the generation budget is a flat 38 clips whatever the benchmark returns.
n_max_plan.cost_at_38_clips: 38 clips at roughly 19 minutes each is about 12 hours of video generation, plus 38 stills at roughly 107s each, about 68 minutes.

audio.how: Muxed under the assembled 1290-frame picture as the last step. The picture is never conformed to the audio; both are exactly 43.000s by construction.

assembly.rule: Concatenate the 38 trimmed clips in order. The result must be exactly 1290 frames. Two seams are composites, not cuts, and need both sides live: f99-f118 (scale-in inset wipe, 02a over 02b) and f1110-f1115 (vertical split-screen wipe, 10a beside 10b).
assembly.do_not: Do not fade, do not dissolve, and do not trim the tail of 11e - f1289 is the last frame of the reel and the 43.000s lock depends on it.

negatives._where_they_apply: NEGATIVE PROMPTS DO NOT APPLY TO THE STILL STAGE. Flux.2 [dev] runs through BasicGuider and has no negative conditioning at all; guidance is carried by FluxGuidance on the positive chain (node_schemas.json TRAP-05). Every negative in this block is for the HunyuanVideo15ImageToVideo stage, which does take positive AND negative conditioning. Unwanted content in a STILL must be handled by rewriting the positive prompt or by re-rolling, not by a negative.
negatives._no_names: No real person, actor, television character or series title appears in these negatives. The gate forbids the tokens outright, so they cannot be used even as exclusions. Identity drift is addressed with descriptive tokens instead.
